title: Extending property tax relief for wildfire-hit properties
summary: On August 25, 2026, Bill 103 changes the budget on the real property tax expiry date for wildfire-impacted properties. The bill would extend a property tax exemption for wildfire-impacted properties to June 30, 2028, which the budget director said lines up the end date with Ordinance 5913. Earlier wildfire tax relief bills, including Bill 147 in 2024, dealt with relief tied to the August 2023 Maui wildfires.
